article.story: CAPE GIRARDEAU, Mo. -- — Marcus Eaves had 20 points, Axton Perry scored 19 and Southeast Missouri State beat NAIA member Midway 115-45 on Monday night. Eaves went 8 of 12 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) for the Redhawks (3-2). Perry shot 9 for 13 and added six rebounds. Clayton Jewell scored 14 on 7-for-10 shooting. Prashant Chouhan led the way for the Eagles with 13 points and two blocks. Midway also got 12 points from Breland Morrison. Southeast Missouri State visits St. Thomas in its next matchup on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
